cohort: The cohort consisted of 117 patients who underwent caesarean hysterectomy for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) in the study clinic.
finding: PAS surgeries performed up to 37 weeks gestation improved neonatal outcomes without increasing maternal complications, although optimal neonatal outcomes after 37 weeks were associated with increased maternal complications, and emergency surgeries led to longer ICU stays and higher transfusion requirements.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean hysterectomies for PAS were associated with longer ICU stays and higher blood transfusion requirements compared to elective procedures.
gest_age: Patients were categorized into groups based on gestational age at surgery: <34 weeks, 34-35 weeks, 35-36 weeks, 36-37 weeks, and >=37 weeks.
